WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_duration,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
  GROUP BY rating
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_duration) AS overall_benchmark
  FROM per_rating
)
SELECT
  p.rating,
  p.avg_rate_per_duration,
  p.film_count,
  p.avg_rate_per_duration / b.overall_benchmark AS benchmark_ratio
FROM per_rating AS p
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE b.overall_benchmark IS NOT NULL;
